receipts.body:
Follow-up selected by #187 for parent epic #180; blocked until #187 is fully verified. No optimization is implemented in #187.

The unchanged reference decision rule is maximum of3fresh renders across7original workloads/14cells:5000ms for frame500ms,8000ms for range[0,100)ms at1920x1080/30fps.13cells pass; row4frame5414.023545ms fails. Warm results cannot rescue it. Original140request rawSHA25601194abacd1fdb644d9a6dda0d0922e6f751b1b9d2b16a6072dc317b9326bd7c, capturedriverdfa3f4cc305eaf48b974f7edbd8cde8d58dae312af8578def6e10e72fa215ff8; initial final-validator error separately corrected/replayed, not a new render. Final187checks pending.

Change ONLY existing render_artifact::extended_visual::Raster::rgba byte-transfer work:256-entry f64 lookup generated by exactly current linear(u8/255), retaining f64 alpha multiplication then f32cast in original order. Repeated powf inner-loop contribution is inferred from source, not independently timed; benefit and target sufficiency are unverified. Moving encoded-cache lookup affectswarm and cannot address this cold miss.

Required proof:
- Separately approve OpenSpec proposal/spec/design/tasks before implementation.
- Exhaustively compare all256channel×256alpha pairs bit-for-bit; preserve RGB/alpha, malformedinput/dimensions and all existing linear-premultiplied semantics.
- Demonstrate exact bounded approximately2KiB immutable scalar storage and existing fixed-overhead accounting without guard/cache budget increases or per-source/user retention.
- Preserve schema45, public declarations/errors/retryability, owner graph, raster identities, warnings/layouts, history/resources and preexisting outputs.
- Preserve independent original native color/alpha/glyph/temporal oracles and cold/warm frame/range/draft/export parity with unchanged tolerances/references.
- Same named issue181 host/release/font/tools and verified actual quotas; controlled before/after exact14cells,3fresh+1excludedwarmup+3repeat+3raster-warm/encoded-cold each. EVERY fresh maximum must meet5000/8000ms; retain5414.023545ms predecessor. Record source/binary/input/host identities, sampled memory, original owner costs and actual cache work; direct inclusive timings remain non-additive, CI timingreport-only.
- If sufficiency fails, report/revisit separately scoped strategy; never erase failure, raise budgets or broaden into a renderer rewrite/precomposition.
- Complete AGENTS.md local/core/bridge/contracts/MCP/package/Python/native/platform checks, independent conformance, sync/archive and protected exact-head CI with unchanged-budget attestation.

Conditional #188/#189 are not selected for187's bounded decision and require explicit not-planned closure links. Release remains blocked on this implementation and #191. Unimplemented96leaf/sixinstance/3000ms targets remain unmeasured. No private production projects, installed desktop, merge, auto-merge, deployment or credential changes.

receipts.title: [IG-08] Preserve sources for static precompositions
receipts.body:
## Parent epic
#180 — Native editable illustrated intro compositions.

## Outcome and scope
Conditional work only if IG-07 justifies static source-preserving precomposition. Add the smallest core representation and lifecycle needed to keep an authoritative editable source subtree associated with disposable derived output.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] If precomposition is not selected, close as not planned with IG-07's decision and no implementation.
- [ ] Restrict the first version to the explicitly approved static visual subtree subset; reject unsupported animated/effect/matte cases instead of flattening them incorrectly.
- [ ] Keep source geometry and managed dependencies authoritative; derived pixels never replace the editable graph.
- [ ] Define complete source identity, revision/freshness, ownership and bounds; source/dependency edits invalidate the derived result.
- [ ] Cover migration if persistence changes, current/retained history, reopen, deletion/garbage collection and failure recovery under existing owners.

## Verification
Core source/derived identity, selective invalidation, graph/resource bounds, history/reopen, missing derived result and atomic failure. Existing direct rendering must remain valid.

## Dependencies
- Blocked by #187: [IG-07] Choose a bounded dense-scene rendering strategy

Implementation is conditional on the documented strategy decision. Closing as not planned is valid only with that decision linked; do not silently waive required work.

## Out of scope
No refresh UI, general nested animated precompositions, arbitrary file references or automatic destructive flattening.

## Repository gates
Follow AGENTS.md and the mandatory issue-scoped OpenSpec lifecycle: approve proposal/spec/design/tasks before behavior changes; verify conformance and archive after checks. Reuse existing native foundations (#23, #28–#31, #36, #46). Keep domain validation/persistence/rendering in editor-core, transports thin, and desktop presentation-only. Preserve compatibility, locks, revisions, atomic rollback and managed resources. Run specification validation plus all applicable Rust, TypeScript, contract, native, MCP, packaged and platform checks; completion requires the protected gate at the exact published head. No merge/deployment authorization is implied.

Conditional disposition from [issue187](https://github.com/matiHirCab/AI-Open-Cut/issues/187): static source-preserving precomposition is not selected for the bounded original workload slice. The retained reference record passes13/14fresh cases; row4frame5414.023545ms misses the5000ms goal. Existing admission budgets remain sufficient. One narrowly scoped exact byte-to-linear conversion candidate was selected; its gain and sufficiency remain unverified. See [the separately scoped implementation and decision](https://github.com/matiHirCab/AI-Open-Cut/issues/203), linked to parent180. This conditional precomposition work is closed as not planned for this decision. The larger96leaf/sixinstance/3000ms envelope remains unmeasured; release remains blocked until selected implementation and191 acceptance pass.

receipts.title: [IG-09] Refresh static precompositions safely
receipts.body:
## Parent epic
#180 — Native editable illustrated intro compositions.

## Outcome and scope
Conditional companion to IG-08: generate and refresh derived output using the existing native renderer and expose its freshness through the existing workflow/desktop surfaces.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] If IG-07 rejects precomposition, close as not planned with its decision; otherwise require IG-08 before implementation.
- [ ] Use native rendering and atomic publication, preserving authoritative sources on failure/cancel.
- [ ] A source edit cannot show an old derived plate as current; refresh binds to the exact source identity/revision and discards late stale results.
- [ ] Expose a small source-edit/freshness/refresh affordance with clear failure state, reusing existing job and UI patterns.
- [ ] Reopening or evicting derived output triggers a safe missing/stale state and supported regeneration, never loss of sources.

## Verification
Direct-versus-refreshed pixel parity; changed palette/artwork/geometry; repeated refresh, cancellation, revision race, failure, undo/redo/reopen and actual GUI observation.

## Dependencies
- Blocked by #188: [IG-08] Preserve sources for static precompositions

Implementation is conditional on #187. Closing as not planned is valid only with that decision linked; do not silently waive required work.

## Out of scope
No durable job system, new renderer, broad media cache browser or duplication of #179 preparation progress.

## Repository gates
Follow AGENTS.md and the mandatory issue-scoped OpenSpec lifecycle: approve proposal/spec/design/tasks before behavior changes; verify conformance and archive after checks. Reuse existing native foundations (#23, #28–#31, #36, #46). Keep domain validation/persistence/rendering in editor-core, transports thin, and desktop presentation-only.
